concept: Practicing something even when it isn't fun yet, because that's how you get better
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character keeps practicing a hard skill, even though the early tries aren't fun, and slowly gets better
exercise.reflection_prompt: What kept the character going when it wasn't fun yet?
exercise.practice: Student names one thing they're practicing that isn't fun yet, and one small next step

assessment.success_marker: student names a real skill they're working on and a specific small next step
